note: Georeference of the sim-drenaje 20 m simulation grid. Full-resolution per-cell products live on W10 only.
originNote: NW corner of the NW cell

crs.name: Mexico ITRF2008 / UTM zone 13N
crs.note: INEGI horizontal datum ITRF08 epoch 2010.0 on GRS80. Treat as WGS84 for web maps (difference well below 1 m).

w10.domain: domain\*.f32|*.u8 (z, phi, n, imp, bld, act, drain, water, wc)
w10.runs: runs\<id>.hmax.u16(.gz) = max depth in mm (uint16), runs\<id>.json = stats + mass balance; tr10-c{0,20,40}-mid.hNNN.u16.gz = depth snapshots every 10 min
w10.products: products\grid\freq15-pct.u8 (255 = water/inactive), flow.f32, fhigh.f32, sens-cm-per-10mmh.f32, gap.u8 (0 none, 1 a, 2 b, 3 c), water.u8
